result.topic_en: Case IV of Euler's treatise on fluid friction: the velocity height of water flowing from a constantly full vessel through an inclined cylindrical tube, with an approximation for a wide, shallow vessel and the condition under which no outflow occurs.
result.transcription:
DE FRICTIONE FLVIDORVM. 371
CASVS IV.
SI AQVA EX VASE CONSTANTER PLENO PER TVBVM CYLINDRICVM INCLINATVM DEFLVAT.
88. Sit vaſis amplitudo $AA=ff$, eiusque altitudo $AB=a$. Tubi inclinati longitudo $BC=b$, amplitudo $BB=gg$, et angulus, quo ad rectam verticalem inclinatur, $=\zeta$, ita vt $\cos.\zeta$ exprimat ſinum inclinationis eius ad horizontem; effluat vero aqua per lumen $CC=kk$, quod prae $ff$ ſit minimum, vt ſit $\frac{k^4}{f^4}=\mathfrak{f}=0$.
Porro ponatur $\frac{k^4}{g^4}=\mathfrak{g}$, $\mathfrak{A}=e^{\frac{-\alpha a}{f}}$, $A=\frac{1-\mathfrak{A}}{\alpha}$; $\mathfrak{B}=e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}}$, et $B=\frac{1-\mathfrak{B}}{\alpha}$; quibus poſitis erit altitudo celeritati, qua aqua per $CC$ effluit, debita
$$v=\frac{A\mathfrak{B}f+Bg\cos.\zeta-(1-\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{B})\,l}{1-\alpha B\mathfrak{g}}$$
89. Cum altitudo vaſis $AB=a$ non ſit admodum magna, et eius amplitudo $ff$ ingens erit $Af=a$, et $\mathfrak{A}=1$, proxime, vnde habebitur
$$v=\frac{a\mathfrak{B}+\frac{1}{\alpha}(1-\mathfrak{B})g\cos.\zeta-(1-\mathfrak{B})\,l}{1-(1-\mathfrak{B})\mathfrak{g}}$$
vbi, cum $\mathfrak{g}$ vnitatem ſuperare nequeat, et ſit $\mathfrak{B}<1$, denominator erit quantitas poſitiua; vnde motus ad vniformitatem perueniet. At ſi numerator fuerit vel $=0$, vel quantitas negatiua, aqua plane non effluet, ſed in quiete perſeuerabit.

items.english: The denominator will be a positive quantity, so the motion will become uniform. But if the numerator is either zero or negative, the water will not flow out at all but will remain at rest.
